project_type: Static web app (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SPA) wrapped as an Android APK via Capacitor 6. The 'Priya ki Dost' / Mayra AI companion app.
language: JavaScript (ES2020, no framework, IIFE modules), Kotlin (Capacitor plugin), HTML, CSS
build_system: npm scripts + Capacitor CLI. scripts/copy-web.js copies root web assets into www/, then `npx cap sync android`, then Gradle (AGP 8.2.1 / Gradle 8.2.1 / Kotlin 1.9.22, Java 17, minSdk 22, compileSdk/targetSdk 34). The real APK is built by GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/build-apk.yml) on GitHub runners.
test_framework: None. No unit test suite exists. Verification is static: `node --check` for JS syntax, XML well-formedness, and JS<->Kotlin method/param name consistency.
build_command: In sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, no network): NOT runnable. Cannot npm install / gradle / cap sync (needs network + Android SDK). Real build happens on GitHub Actions. Local sanity: `node scripts/copy-web.js` (pure Node, no deps) copies assets to www/.
test_command: No test runner. Static verification only: run `unset NODE_OPTIONS` first (NODE_OPTIONS has a preload that breaks the node CLI), then `node --check <file.js>` on every changed JS file; check XML well-formedness (python3 xml.etree or xmllint); grep to confirm JS<->Kotlin method names and App/AndroidBridge exports match HTML onclick references.
verification_instructions: 1) `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check` each changed .js file. 2) Validate AndroidManifest.xml and any new res/xml files are well-formed XML. 3) Confirm every App.* and AndroidBridge.* method referenced from index.html onclick attributes is present in the respective module's returned public API object. 4) Confirm JS permission names ('microphone'|'contacts'|'location') and native method names/params (requestPermission{permission}, checkPermission{permission}, openAccessibilitySettings, isAccessibilityEnabled) match EXACTLY between android-bridge.js and MayraAndroidPlugin.kt. 5) Confirm new API hosts (api.groq.com, api.openai.com) are added to sw.js never-cache bypass. Do NOT attempt a network build in the sandbox.
snapshot_or_generated_files: www/ is a generated copy of root web assets produced by scripts/copy-web.js (gitignored, rebuilt on each CI run). No checked-in generated files. Do not commit www/.
setup_instructions: No local setup possible in sandbox (no network). On CI: setup-node 20, Temurin JDK 17, android-actions/setup-android, `npm install`, `npm run copy:web`, `npx cap sync android`, `./gradlew assembleRelease`.
environment_constraints: NETWORK MODE = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. NO external internet: cannot npm install, run gradle, cap sync, or download Android SDK. Cannot compile the Kotlin plugin locally (verify Kotlin by careful reading + API-signature consistency, not compilation). Cannot make live API calls to Gemini/Groq/OpenAI. All verification is static. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before invoking node CLI.
contribution_requirements: Additive only: must NOT break existing working features (Gemini voice WebSocket pipeline, Gemini chat, Gemini function-calling, onboarding flow, dark mode, Iconsax UI). Keys stay on-device, never logged, only sent to the chosen provider. All user-facing text stays in Mayra's warm Hinglish voice (never raw error/system strings). Cross-consistency rules: new top-level web file -> add to scripts/copy-web.js ITEMS; new API host -> add to sw.js never-cache rule AND (if a new .js file) sw.js APP_SHELL + index.html <script>; new App/AndroidBridge method used in HTML onclick -> add to that module's public export; JS<->Kotlin names/params must match exactly. .github/workflows/*.yml changes go via PR, NOT a direct main push (report separately).
key_patterns: Storage: IIFE returning public API; KEYS map + XOR obfuscate/deobfuscate wrapping localStorage; single-key API storage today (getApiKey/setApiKey/hasApiKey/clearApiKey) and setPermission/getPermission using a hardcoded mic-vs-contacts ternary (must generalize to a name->KEY map covering mic/contacts/location/accessibility). App: IIFE assigned to window.App; inline onclick in index.html calls App.method -> ANY new method used from HTML MUST be in the returned object at the bottom. validateAndSaveApiKey(context) where context is 'onboard'|'settings'. _testApiKey(key) currently returns false on any fetch throw (network failure reads as invalid - the ROOT CAUSE of problem 1). GeminiChat.send(userText, apiKey, systemInstruction) -> Gemini REST; reads Storage.getChatHistory(); handles function calls. GeminiVoice: Gemini Live WebSocket (Gemini-only). MayraFunctions.TOOL_DECLARATIONS + execute() + buildFollowUpPrompt(). AndroidBridge: _native() detects window.Capacitor.Plugins.MayraAndroid; requestPermission/checkPermission with web fallbacks; public API object at bottom. MayraAndroidPlugin.kt: @CapacitorPlugin(name='MayraAndroid'); openApp/openUrl/makeCall/callContact/openSettings are real; requestPermission is a STUB returning {granted:false}. Iconsax icons are inline <symbol id='isax-*'> in index.html <head>; existing ids: home-2, heart, discover, user, gift, key, microphone, call, message, send, arrow-left, moon, setting-2, edit-2, volume-high. There is NO location or accessibility/shield icon yet - add new <symbol> entries if needed. CSS classes for permission rows: .permission-item, .perm-status with .granted/.denied/.unknown modifiers.

directory_structure: Root: index.html, manifest.json, sw.js, capacitor.config.json, package.json. css/ (styles.css). js/ (storage.js, app.js, gemini-chat.js, gemini-voice.js, functions.js, android-bridge.js). assets/ (icons, iconsax sprite). scripts/ (copy-web.js). android/ (Capacitor Android project; app/src/main/java/com/priyakidost/mayra/*.kt, app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, app/src/main/res/xml/*, variables.gradle). .github/workflows/build-apk.yml (CI build; changes require a PR, not direct main push).
